title: Scene 5 · T5 — Insert — the brush works the stripe; white turns to her skin behind it (SH07)
line: It reads your skin and becomes your exact shade. The niacinamide takes the red down. It settles into the lines instead of cracking on top.
motionPlan: the brush end works the white stripe in small circles; behind the brush the white turns to her own skin tone, ahead of it the stripe stays white
